translations.asad: THE MOST GRACIOUS
translations.sahih: The Most Merciful

translations.asad: has imparted this Qur’an [unto man].
translations.sahih: Taught the Qur'an,

translations.asad: He has created man:
translations.sahih: Created man,

translations.asad: He has imparted unto him articulate thought and speech.
translations.sahih: [And] taught him eloquence.

translations.asad: [At His behest] the sun and the moon run their appointed courses;
translations.sahih: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

translations.asad: [before Him] prostrate them­selves the stars and the trees.
translations.sahih: And the stars and trees prostrate.

translations.asad: And the skies has He raised high, and has devised [for all things] a measure,
translations.sahih: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

translations.asad: so that you [too, O men,] might never transgress the measure [of what is right]:
translations.sahih: That you not transgress within the balance.

text.arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ

translations.asad: weigh, therefore, [your deeds] with equity, and cut not the measure short!
translations.sahih: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

translations.asad: And the earth has He spread out for all living beings,
translations.sahih: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

translations.asad: with fruit thereon, and palm trees with sheathed clusters [of dates],
translations.sahih: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

translations.asad: and grain growing tall on its stalks, and sweet-smelling plants.
translations.sahih: And grain having husks and scented plants.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: He has created man out of sounding clay, like pottery,
translations.sahih: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

text.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ

translations.asad: whereas the invisible beings He has created out of a confusing flame of fire.
translations.sahih: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: [He is] the Sustainer of the two farthest points of sunrise, and the Sustainer of the two farthest points of sunset.
translations.sahih: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustain­er’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: He has given freedom to the two great bodies of water, so that they might meet:
translations.sahih: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];

translations.asad: [yet] between them is a barrier which they may not transgress.
translations.sahih: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: Out of these two [bodies of water] come forth pearls, both great and small.
translations.sahih: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ

translations.asad: And His are the lofty ships that sail like [floating] mountains through the seas.
translations.sahih: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: All that lives on earth or in the heavens is bound to pass away:
translations.sahih: Everyone upon the earth will perish,

text.arabic: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

translations.asad: but forever will abide thy Sustainer’s Self, full of majesty and glory.
translations.sahih: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ

translations.asad: On Him depends all creatures in the heavens and on earth; [and] every day He manifests Himself in yet another [wondrous] way.
translations.sahih: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: [ONE DAY] We shall take you to task, O you sin-laden two!
translations.sahih: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text.arabic: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ

translations.asad: O you who live in close communion with [evil] invisible beings and humans! If you [think that you] can pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, pass beyond them! [But] you cannot pass beyond them, save by a sanction [from God]!
translations.sahih: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text.arabic: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ

translations.asad: A flash of fire will be let loose upon you, and smoke, and you will be left without succour!
translations.sahih: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ

translations.asad: And when the sky is rent asunder and becomes red like [burning] oil
translations.sahih: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -

translations.asad: which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

text.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ

translations.asad: For on that Day neither man nor invisible being will be asked about his sins.
translations.sahih: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text.arabic: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ

translations.asad: All who were lost in sin shall by their marks be known, and shall by their forelocks and their feet be seized!
translations.sahih: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

translations.asad: This will be the hell which those who are lost in sin [now] call a lie:
translations.sahih: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

translations.asad: between it and [their own] burning-hot despair will they wander to and fro!
translations.sahih: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: BUT FOR THOSE who of their Sustainer’s Presence stand in fear, two gardens [of paradise are readied] -
translations.sahih: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -

translations.asad: which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow? –
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

translations.asad: [two gardens] of many wondrous hues.
translations.sahih: Having [spreading] branches.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: In [each of] these two [gardens] two springs will flow.
translations.sahih: In both of them are two springs, flowing.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: In [each of] these two will two kinds of every fruit be [found].
translations.sahih: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ

translations.asad: [In such a paradise the blest will dwell,] reclin­ing upon carpets lined with rich brocade; and the fruit of both these gardens will be within easy reach.
translations.sahih: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text.arabic: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ

translations.asad: In these [gardens] will be mates of modest gaze, whom neither man nor invisible being will have touched ere then.
translations.sahih: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sus­tainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

translations.asad: [When you are promised splendours] as though [of] rubies and [of] pearls –
translations.sahih: As if they were rubies and coral.

translations.asad: which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: Could the reward of good be aught but good?
translations.sahih: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: And besides those two will be yet two [other] gardens -
translations.sahih: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -

translations.asad: which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow? –
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

translations.asad: two [gardens] of the deepest green.
translations.sahih: Dark green [in color].

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: In [each of] these two [gardens] will two springs gush forth.
translations.sahih: In both of them are two springs, spouting.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sus­tainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: In both of them will be [all kinds of] fruit, and date-palms and pomegranates.
translations.sahih: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

translations.asad: In these [gardens] will be [all] things most excellent and beautiful.
translations.sahih: In them are good and beautiful women -

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

translations.asad: [There the blest will live with their] companions pure and modest, in pavilions [splendid] -
translations.sahih: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -

translations.asad: which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow? –
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

text.arabic: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ

translations.asad: [companions] whom neither man nor invisible being will have touched ere then.
translations.sahih: Untouched before them by man or jinni -

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

text.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ

translations.asad: [In such a paradise will they dwell,] reclining upon meadows green and carpets rich in beauty.
translations.sahih: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

translations.asad: Which, then, of your Sustainer’s powers can you disavow?
translations.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

text.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

translations.asad: HALLOWED be thy Sustainer’s name, full of majesty and glory!
translations.sahih: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
